description: 暦年・年度別空港管理状況調書(H24~R3) [airports] is a dataset listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 各空港の利用状況（着陸回数、乗降客数、貨物量、郵便量、給油量）の直近10年分を暦年・年度別に集計し、公表している。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. Its tags are 交通, 人の移動_ツーリズムに関する情報, 空港, 統計, 航空. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2023-06-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
